articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How BofA’s Upgrade and New Tech Initiatives Will Impact Comcast (CMCSA) Investors. Earlier this month, BofA upgraded Comcast, arguing the company is well placed to benefit as the media and cable industry undergoes major structural change across content, technology, and live experiences. At the same time, Comcast is expanding multi-gigabit broadband in Maryland and rolling out new political streaming ad tools, underlining how it is leaning into both connectivity and advanced media monetization.
